question: Is the installed npm/PyPI distribution byte-equivalent to the pinned Git tag source, and may lazy-intel treat the distribution as the fork source?
answer: The executable payload of both Node distributions is byte-reproducible from the pinned Git commits (measured). The CodeGraph *root npm package* is still not a build of the tag: it is a thin installer around a per-platform bundle, with a GitHub Releases download fallback. The fork is therefore taken from the pinned Git checkout, which is exactly the source those bundles were built from.

@zvec/zvec-grep@0.2.1.gitHead_note: The registry record carries no gitHead, so the registry itself does not assert a source commit.
@zvec/zvec-grep@0.2.1.evidence: prepack runs `npm run build` = `tsc -p tsconfig.json` only; `files` publishes dist + docs + licence. dist/ contains only compiled JS/d.ts/maps, no vendored runtime and no prebuilt native code. A tsc build of the pinned commit should therefore reproduce dist/.
@zvec/zvec-grep@0.2.1.gate: CLOSED in U02 by the measurement above.

reproducible_build_measured.method: npm ci then npm run build (tsc -p tsconfig.json) in vendor/zvec-grep on Node v22.22.3, then sha256 of every file in dist/ against node_modules/@zvec/zvec-grep/dist/
reproducible_build_measured.conclusion: All 390 published dist files are byte-identical to a local build of the pinned commit. The npm distribution is a faithful build of 309a6699 even though the registry record carries no gitHead.

@colbymchenry/codegraph@1.6.0.gitHead_note: The registry asserts exactly the pinned commit, so the release was cut from this source tree.
findings: The published root package.json is rewritten at release time: main becomes ./npm-sdk.js and bin becomes ./npm-shim.js, while the tag declares main dist/index.js and bin ./dist/bin/codegraph.js.
The published root `dist/` contains only .d.ts declarations. There is no executable JavaScript in the root package at all.
All executable code ships in the per-platform optionalDependency @colbymchenry/codegraph-<platform>-<arch>, which bundles a 120,573,328-byte vendored Node runtime plus lib/dist and lib/kernel.

npm-shim.js contains a GitHub Releases download fallback (CODEGRAPH_DOWNLOAD_BASE / CODEGRAPH_INSTALL_DIR, disabled by CODEGRAPH_NO_DOWNLOAD=1) that fires whenever the platform bundle cannot be resolved. That is a network install reachable from ordinary invocation.

asset_parity_measured.method: sha256 of every tree-sitter grammar and the SQL schema, pinned checkout src/ versus the installed platform bundle lib/dist/
asset_parity_measured.conclusion: The platform bundle is a build of this tag: its inner package.json equals the tag's and every copy-assets artefact is byte-identical. JavaScript byte parity is still unproven because no reproducible tsc build was run.

consequences_for_lazy_intel: vendor/codegraph MUST be imported from the pinned Git checkout. The npm root package has no source to fork.

The current runtime dependency @colbymchenry/codegraph@1.6.0 executes on a vendored Node 24, not on the host Node. Moving CodeGraph in-process changes its runtime; node:sqlite availability on the host Node must be proven in U03.
The shim's release-download fallback must be unreachable once vendored. U09 must prove an offline cold start.
@colbymchenry/codegraph@1.6.0.gate: CLOSED in U02 for the executable payload. The wrapper remains out-of-tree by design and is dropped by vendoring.

reproducible_build_measured.method: npm ci then npm run build (tsc + copy-assets) in vendor/codegraph on Node v22.22.3, then sha256 of every file in dist/ against node_modules/@colbymchenry/codegraph-darwin-arm64/lib/dist/
reproducible_build_measured.conclusion: All 742 files of the platform bundle's lib/dist are byte-identical to a local build of the pinned commit. The executable payload is exactly this source; only the packaging wrapper (npm-shim.js, npm-sdk.js, the vendored Node runtime and the rewritten root package.json) has no counterpart in the tag.

serena-agent@1.7.0.evidence: lazy-intel does not install serena-agent from PyPI today; src/backends/serena.js speaks MCP stdio to an externally provisioned Serena (src/backends/serena.js:1-6, StdioMcpClient + resolveBin).
serena-agent@1.7.0.gate: U05 pins the exact interpreter and the real import closure of the private semantic worker; only then is a distribution comparison meaningful.

rules_upheld: No tag, semver range, or published tarball was substituted for a pinned commit.
Pinned tag source is not treated as proof of package byte equivalence.
